definition.title: Appreciating your experience with Vertix
definition.description:
We want to thank you for your time and patience.

**Your experience with Vertix is important to us, and we would love to hear your feedback.**

We strive to provide the best possible service, and your input can help us achieve that.

If you have any suggestions, concerns, or ideas on how we can improve Vertix, please don't hesitate to share them with us.

Your feedback is highly appreciated and will contribute to making Vertix even better.

Thank you for using Vertix, and we look forward to hearing your thoughts!

definition.title: 🛠  Setup Vertix
definition.description:
Discover the limitless possibilities of **Vertix**!
Customize and optimize your server to perfection.

To create a new master channel just click:
`(➕ Create Master Channel)` button.

Master Channels are dynamic voice channel generators, each with its own unique configuration.

Our badwords feature enables guild-level configuration for limiting dynamic channel names.

_**Current master channels**_:
{masterChannelMessage}

_Current badwords_:
{badwordsMessage}

-# 💡 You can set logs channel by editing the master channel.

definition.title: ༄ Vertix is here, let's get started!
definition.description:
Welcome to Vertix, an incredible addition to your server!
Let's collaborate and make your server even better.

**Bot Setup**
- Type `/setup` or press `(🛠 Setup)` button.
- Click on `(➕ Create Master Channel)`
- Follow the steps.

Still not sure? Check out our [step by step](https://vertix.gg/posts/how-to-setup) guide.

You can always edit the configurations by using the `/setup` command.

If you need assistance or have any suggestions, feel free to join our Discord community server! We would be glad to help you and hear your feedback.

Join us at: https://discord.gg/dEwKeQefUU
